# Skill: run-realworld-docs-dev

**When to use:** Preview or edit the RealWorld Starlight documentation site under realworld/docs.

## Scope
- `realworld/docs`

## Prerequisites
- Bun or npm available; install dependencies in realworld/docs (deploy-docs.yml uses bun install in docs working directory per analysis)

## Steps
1. Change directory to realworld/docs.
2. Run bun run dev or bun run start (both run astro dev per realworld/docs/package.json).
3. For production check, run bun run build (astro check && astro build).

## Existing example
- `realworld/docs/package.json scripts dev, start, build.`

## Sources
- [`realworld/docs/package.json`](../../realworld/docs/package.json)
- [`realworld/docs/astro.config.mjs`](../../realworld/docs/astro.config.mjs)

## Verification
- cd realworld/docs && bun run dev (status: documented)
- cd realworld/docs && bun run build (status: documented)
